card.name: Fitness and exercise-frequency phrases
card.fires_on: Small words and nouns inside fitness and diet advice, such as "per" in times per week, "fat" before loss, and "of" in frequency of exercise. It fires where the next word is likely to stress what matters most.

modes.label: Frequency of exercise
modes.description: Words in phrases about how often people exercise or how much time is spent.
modes.example: 2 to 3 times<< per>> week and 4 or more times per

modes.label: Fat loss emphasis
modes.description: The word fat or the words around it in advice to focus on fat loss.
modes.example: Make sure that you focus on<< fat>> loss not weight loss.

modes.label: Other training and nutrition phrases
modes.description: Linking words or parts of words in sports training and nutrition advice.
modes.example: the optimal time<< to>> eat carbohydrate-rich foods and drinks.

card.writes: It nudges the output toward words like priority and precedence, as in what to put first.
card.plain: It lights up in exercise and diet advice where the text is about what to focus on or how often to do something.
